response.justification: Bogdan brings roughly 15 years of hands-on engineering across web, backend, mobile, and embedded systems, plus founder experience with an open-source geo-data platform and a strong record of teaching and public speaking — all genuine positives. However, the role is a Director-level individual contributor focused on AI strategy, requiring recognized AI expertise, demonstrated AI products or platforms, and deep cloud-platform fluency used to advise strategic customers and shape future product direction. The resume shows only recent, peripheral AI exposure (MCP code generators and agent tooling at re:cinq), limited cloud-architecture depth beyond AWS CDK and Kubernetes deployment, and no evidence of executive-level influence, strategy ownership, or external advisory work. The seniority trajectory (Senior/Staff IC) is also a step or two below the Principal/Director scope of this position.
strengths: ~15 years of broad, hands-on engineering across web, backend, mobile, and embedded
Founder of an open-source geo-data platform with real users (entrepreneurial signal)
Strong craftsmanship and knowledge-sharing record: TDD, OSS tooling, conference talks, workshops
concerns: No demonstrated AI/ML expertise or shipped AI products beyond early agent tooling
Career level (Senior/Staff IC) below Principal/Director-level IC scope
Little evidence of cloud platform strategy or advising strategic customers/partners

key_factors.factor: Depth and breadth of engineering experience
